jobs.title: Director, Analytics & Insights
jobs.description:
Department:
Technology

Location:
Toronto, ON

Compensation:
CA$130,000 - CA$170,000 / year

Description

What we do every day to be our very best

Every day at Securian Canada means a day spent helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. We’re agile and innovative, and we aren't afraid to challenge and create, or bring diverse perspectives to our work.

Who We Need

As our Director, Analytics & Insights
, you'll help shape how data drives decisions across Securian Canada.

We're looking for a leader who sees beyond dashboards and reports. Someone who is energized by complex business challenges, naturally curious about what drives performance, and passionate about transforming data into meaningful business outcomes. You'll play a pivotal role in building and evolving an enterprise analytics capability
that empowers leaders with trusted insights, scalable analytics products, modern business intelligence, and practical AI-enabled solutions
.

Reporting to the AVP, Data Solutions, you'll lead a multidisciplinary team
responsible for Analytics & Insights, Business Intelligence, and Analytics Engineering. Working across business and technology teams, you'll help create a shared understanding of customers, products, markets, financial performance, and organizational priorities, enabling smarter decisions at every level of the organization.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on leadership
. You'll influence enterprise priorities
, guide complex analytical initiatives, challenge assumptions, and help leaders translate insights into action.

The leader we're looking for combines strong business judgment with technical depth
. You start with the decision that needs to be made, not the tool that will be used. You understand that data and analytics are strategic business assets
and know how to balance immediate business needs with scalable enterprise solutions. You're pragmatic, collaborative, governance-minded, and skilled at translating complex analytical concepts into compelling business narratives that drive action.

Most importantly, you're passionate about building high-performing teams
, developing talent
, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment where people can do their best work while making a meaningful impact
.

At Securian Canada, analytics is about more than understanding what happened. It's about helping people make better decisions that support our mission of helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. You'll join a team of talented professionals who are committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and creating solutions that make a real difference across our business.

The base salary range for this position is between $130,000 to $170,000 depending on experience. Details of our additional benefits are outlined below. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Only one position is available. However, it may be based in multiple locations: Toronto (ON), or Waterloo (ON), or Montreal (QC).

What You Will Do

Lead Enterprise Analytics Strategy & Decision Support

Define and execute an analytics and insights roadmap aligned with enterprise, market, customer, and partner priorities.
Transform strategic business questions into actionable analytical opportunities, KPI frameworks, data requirements, and decision-support solutions.
Deliver meaningful insights into business performance, customer behaviour, claims experience, product results, portfolio trends, operational effectiveness, and emerging risks.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives that drive informed decision-making.
Establish scalable practices that improve prioritization, delivery, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.

Build Modern Analytics Products & Business Intelligence Capabilities

Lead the evolution from fragmented reporting toward trusted, enterprise-scale analytics products.
Oversee the development of curated datasets, semantic models, certified metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and client-facing reporting solutions.
Partner with Data Pipeline Engineering, Technology, Governance, Finance, and business leaders to strengthen analytics foundations and support critical business priorities.
Improve self-service analytics capabilities while reducing manual effort, duplicated logic, and disconnected solutions.
Ensure analytics products are scalable, reliable, understandable, and centered around real business decisions.

Advance AI, Machine Learning & Analytical Innovation

Identify practical opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, and AI can create measurable business value.
Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, data readiness, adoption potential, and long-term sustainability.
Establish governance, controls, explainability, data quality standards, and operating requirements needed to support responsible AI and advanced analytics.
Guide innovative solutions from ideation through implementation, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and long-term success.

Develop High-Performing Teams & Analytics Capabilities

Lead, coach, and inspire a team of professionals across analytics, insights, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics engineering.
Foster a culture focused on analytical excellence, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and business partnership.
Provide guidance on analytical problem solving, data-product design, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
Help team members grow beyond traditional reporting by strengthening skills in problem framing, root-cause analysis, insight generation, and strategic recommendations.
Create an environment where innovation, curiosity, and measurable business outcomes are valued and celebrated.

Build Strong Partnerships Across the Organization

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping connect business priorities to data-driven solutions.
Build strong relationships across Data Solutions, Technology, Finance, Operations, and business teams.
Influence decision-making by bringing clarity, insight, and strategic perspective to complex challenges.
Champion a data-informed culture that increases confidence, consistency, and trust in organizational decision-making.

What You Will Bring

University degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data science, decision support, or related fields, including leadership responsibilities.
Demonstrated success building, transforming, or significantly advancing enterprise analytics capabilities within a complex organization.
Strong experience translating ambiguous business challenges into actionable analytical solutions, meaningful insights, and measurable outcomes.
Deep expertise in SQL, Python, analytical data modeling, business intelligence platforms, and modern cloud data environments.
Experience developing scalable analytical datasets, curated data products, KPI frameworks, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions.
Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, from source systems and data engineering through analytics delivery and business consumption.
Experience applying advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, or AI-enabled solutions to business challenges.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders while effectively leading highly technical teams.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience building, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.
Experience within insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is considered an asset.
Experience with cloud data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, and modern self-service BI platforms.
Knowledge of responsible AI practices, model governance, data quality, lineage, explainability, and operational controls.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and inspire action through data.
A strategic and product-oriented mindset focused on delivering sustainable, scalable solutions that create long-term business value.

Why join?

When you’re a part of Securian Canada, you’re a member of an agile and innovative, high-performing, bright-thinking, make-things-happen culture – so that together, we can discover the art of possible.

At our company, we see your potential on day one and challenge you to grow your unique strengths as you create a career filled with opportunity, collaboration, and purpose.

You’ll also be part of a team that’s committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and who values diverse perspectives, so that you can be the person you want to be – both in, and outside, work.

Securian Canada offers a competitive total rewards program with a variety of perks and benefits, including:

Flexible work arrangements with monthly financial allocations to support your work-life balance;
Generous starting paid vacation time, plus additional vacation days for every year of service;
Paid volunteer day so you can dedicate time to a cause you are passionate about;
Paid personal and wellness days to support your total wellbeing;
Educational assistance of up to $3,500 a year (with approval from your manager);
Flexible health and wellness account (in addition to comprehensive drug and dental coverage) to help pay for a wide range of wellbeing services that are meaningful to you;
Up to 14% of combined contributions to the RRSP matching program;
Family-friendly maternity/parental leave and,
Many more benefits, perks and programs.

If you have at least 70% of the qualifications we're looking for, want to work in a fast-growing, leading and progressive company, and feel driven to help Canadians and their families build secure futures – we want to hear from you!

Take the first step in building your future with Securian Canada. Apply now.

jobs.title: Chef(fe) de l’analyse marketing / Head of Marketing Analytics
jobs.description:
Brief Description

Qui est Manmade?

Nous sommes un détaillant en ligne de produits essentiels de première qualité basé à Montréal, connu particulièrement jusqu'à présent pour nos boxer pour hommes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide depuis notre lancement en 2021, et la marque est véritablement à un tournant pour devenir un nom familier au Canada, et elle se développe déjà en parallèle sur le marché américain.

Qui recherchons-nous?

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de l’analytique marketing
pour bâtir et diriger la fonction d’analytique marketing de Manmade.

Vous serez responsable de la façon dont nous mesurons et interprétons la performance marketing, en regroupant les données de nos différents canaux pour offrir une vision claire et fiable des facteurs qui contribuent aux résultats de l’entreprise. Une priorité sera de créer une source de référence unique et centralisée
pour la performance marketing et de mettre en place les tableaux de bord, les indicateurs clés de performance et les cadres de mesure qui guideront les décisions de nos équipes.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior avec une forte implication opérationnelle
. Vous devrez explorer les données, créer des tableaux de bord, analyser la performance et résoudre vous-même les problèmes, tout en établissant les bases d’une équipe et d’une fonction capables d’évoluer avec Manmade.

Si vous aimez transformer des données complexes en décisions d’affaires claires et souhaitez bâtir une fonction à partir de zéro, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?

Nous nous développons rapidement, les choses changent vite et une présence en interne est nécessaire.

Ce que nous offrons?
Nous pensons qu'un travail de qualité commence par un environnement de qualité. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous bénéficierez de déjeuners quotidiens gratuits, de collations et de boissons pour vous permettre de rester en forme et concentré. Nous offrons une assurance de groupe payée à 100 %, des salaires compétitifs qui sont révisés régulièrement avec des augmentations annuelles garanties, et une structure de primes de partage des bénéfices pour que tout le monde participe à notre succès.

Nous sommes dans une phase de croissance, ce qui signifie de réelles opportunités pour vous d'apprendre, de vous développer et de faire passer votre carrière au niveau supérieur. Avant tout, vous ferez partie d'une culture amusante, innovante et respectueuse où vos idées sont valorisées et où votre impact est réel.

Responsabilités

Bâtir et prendre en charge la fonction d’analytique et de mesure marketing de Manmade, tant pour l’acquisition que pour la fidélisation de la clientèle.
Créer une source de référence unique pour la performance marketing en regroupant les données de Meta, Google, TikTok, du marketing par courriel, du marketing d’influence, de Shopify et de l’analytique Web.
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance et des rapports offrant aux équipes Marketing et à la direction une vision claire de la performance.
Analyser les indicateurs clés, notamment le coût d’acquisition client (CAC), la valeur vie client (LTV), le rendement des dépenses publicitaires (ROAS), le ratio d’efficacité marketing (MER), la rétention, la conversion, les cohortes de clients et la performance des canaux.
Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing et Finance pour relier les investissements et la performance marketing aux revenus, à la rentabilité par client et à une croissance rentable.
Évaluer la performance des canaux, des campagnes, des audiences et des créations publicitaires, puis traduire les résultats en recommandations claires et concrètes.
Développer l’approche de Manmade en matière d’attribution, d’incrémentalité, d’expérimentation et de mesure marketing, notamment au moyen de tests A/B, de tests géographiques et de groupes témoins.
Consolider et valider les données provenant des différentes plateformes afin de garantir l’exactitude et la fiabilité des rapports.
Mener des analyses approfondies pour répondre à des questions d’affaires complexes et repérer des occasions d’amélioration en matière d’acquisition, de fidélisation et de valeur vie client.
Mettre en place des processus, des outils et une infrastructure analytiques capables de soutenir la croissance, et définir la feuille de route de la fonction.
Maintenir une forte implication opérationnelle tout en bâtissant et en dirigeant, à terme, une équipe d’analytique marketing performante.

Éxigences

De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience progressive en analytique marketing, en analytique de croissance, en intelligence d’affaires, en analyse de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
Solide expérience en commerce électronique, en vente directe aux consommateurs (DTC), dans le secteur des produits de consommation ou au sein d’une autre entreprise numérique à forte croissance.
Expérience démontrée dans la création ou le développement d’une fonction d’analytique marketing, notamment les tableaux de bord, les cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance, les rapports et les processus de mesure.
Maîtrise avancée de SQL et d’Excel, ainsi qu’une solide expérience avec des outils d’intelligence d’affaires comme Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des outils similaires.
Expérience avec Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok et d’autres plateformes de marketing numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du CAC, de la LTV, du ROAS, du MER, de la rétention, de la conversion, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’attribution et de la rentabilité par client.
Expérience en expérimentation marketing et en mesure de l’incrémentalité, notamment les tests A/B, les tests géographiques et les groupes témoins.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la performance marketing aux résultats commerciaux et financiers de l’entreprise.
Capacité à définir la stratégie analytique tout en explorant personnellement les données et en développant des solutions.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à traduire des données complexes en constats clairs pour les équipes Marketing, Finance et la direction.
Une expérience dans la constitution d’équipes, le mentorat ou la gestion de professionnels en analytique est fortement souhaitée.
Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

Who is Manmade?

We’re a Montreal-based online retailer of premium quality essentials, known particularly so far for our men’s boxer briefs. We have been rapidly growing since launching in 2021, and the brand is truly at a turning point to becoming a household name in Canada, and already growing rapidly in parallel in the US market.

Who is Manmade looking for?

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing Analytics
to build and lead Manmade’s marketing analytics function.

You’ll own how we measure and understand marketing performance, bringing together data across our channels to create a clear, trusted view of what’s driving the business. A key priority will be building a unified source of truth
for marketing performance and establishing the dashboards, KPIs, and measurement frameworks our teams use to make decisions.

This is a senior but deeply hands-on role
. You’ll be expected to dig into the data, build dashboards, analyze performance, and solve problems yourself while creating the foundation for a team and function that can scale with Manmade.

If you love turning complex data into clear business decisions and want the opportunity to build something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Is this for you?

We are growing so rapidly so things are changing so quickly and an in-house presence is required

What are we offering?
Aside from a competitive compensation package, the opportunity in itself is what you make of it. With the company growing 250%+ year over year for the past 3 years, and with expected growth to continue at a high pace for the next 2-3 years, there will be many different ways to grow within the company as it enters new markets, channels, and so on.

We offer extended health and dental benefits, 100% fully paid by the employer. We offer catered lunches every day and all the snacks, drinks, coffee, and fruit you could want.

Responsibilities

Own and build Manmade’s marketing analytics and measurement function across customer acquisition and retention.
Create a unified source of truth for marketing performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, Email, Influencer, Shopify, and web analytics.
Build and maintain dashboards, KPI frameworks, and reporting that give Marketing and leadership a clear view of performance.
Analyze key metrics including CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, customer cohorts, and channel performance.
Partner with Marketing and Finance to connect marketing investment and performance to revenue, customer economics, and profitable growth.
Evaluate channel, campaign, audience, and creative performance and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Develop Manmade’s approach to attribution, incrementality, experimentation, and marketing measurement, including A/B tests, geo studies, and holdouts.
Consolidate and validate data across platforms, ensuring reporting is accurate, reliable, and trusted.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to answer complex business questions and identify opportunities across acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value.
Build scalable analytics processes, tools, and infrastructure, and establish the roadmap for the function as Manmade grows.
Remain deeply hands-on while eventually building and leading a high-performing marketing analytics team.

Qualifications

7–10 years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong experience in e-commerce, DTC, consumer, or another high-growth digital business.
Proven experience building or scaling a marketing analytics function, including dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting, and measurement processes.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel, with strong experience in BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience with Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok, and other digital marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, cohort analysis, attribution, and customer economics.
Experience with marketing experimentation and incrementality, including A/B testing, geo testing, and holdouts.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing performance to broader business and financial outcomes.
Ability to operate at both levels: setting analytics strategy while personally digging into the data and building solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for Marketing, Finance, and leadership.
Experience building, mentoring, or leading analytics talent is strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Interim Vice President, Finance
jobs.description:
Duration:
6 months Contract
Work Model:
Hybrid, 3 days onsite
Location:
Toronto Downtown/Yorkville Area
Pay:
$75 - $90/hr

Position Overview

We are seeking an interim Vice President, Finance.
Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, this individual will oversee the finance function and provide leadership across reporting, planning, controls, audit, and broader finance operations. The role requires someone who can operate at both a strategic and hands-on level, while supporting business priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the finance function across reporting, planning, controls, and audit execution
Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting for senior leadership and other key stakeholders
Direct the annual budget process, forecasting cycles, and financial planning.
Maintain a strong financial control environment and support sound governance
Lead year-end financial statement preparation and manage external audit activity
Oversee cash management, liquidity planning, and treasury-related responsibilities
Provide oversight for tax filings and related compliance requirements
Review contracts and provide financial oversight related to vendors, procurement, and commercial commitments
Mentor, lead, and develop the finance team while driving accountability and strong performance

Required Background

CPA designation required
University degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field
Progressive senior finance leadership experience within complex, fast-paced organizations
Strong expertise across financial reporting, controllership, planning and analysis, audit, cash management, and operational finance
Proven ability to lead and develop teams while creating structure, ownership, and accountability
Experience supporting change, managing multiple priorities, and driving execution in evolving environments
Strong communication skills and executive presence, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders
Ideal profile includes a polished and commercially minded finance leader coming from a larger company environment

Interested?

If you are a senior finance leader available for an interim mandate and interested in making an immediate impact, we’d welcome the opportunity to connect and discuss the role further.

jobs.title: Finance Director (6 month contract)
jobs.description:
This is a 6 month contract with permanent potential at the end of the contract

About the Opportunity

Lead the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS
and applicable regulatory requirements.
Oversee the financial reporting process
, ensuring accurate, timely, and complete reporting to senior management, the Board, and other stakeholders.
Manage the year-end audit process
, serving as the primary contact for external auditors and coordinating the preparation of audit schedules and supporting documentation.
Ensure appropriate application and interpretation of new and evolving IFRS standards
, assessing their impact on the organization and implementing required changes.
Oversee technical accounting matters
, including complex transactions, revenue recognition, leases, financial instruments, consolidations, and other IFRS-related issues.
Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls
to ensure compliance with IFRS and promote the integrity of financial reporting.
Lead the month-end and quarter-end close processes
, identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness.
Review financial results and provide variance analysis and financial insights
to senior leadership, highlighting key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Oversee the preparation of management reporting, financial analysis, budgets, forecasts, and financial models
to support strategic decision-making.
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounting team
, fostering a high-performing environment with strong accountability, technical expertise, and continuous improvement.

General Financial Oversight:
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, highlighting key metrics and trends.
Assist in developing financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to streamline financial operations.
Work closely with senior leadership to support business decisions and optimize financial performance.

new_jobs.title: Chef(fe) de l’analyse marketing / Head of Marketing Analytics
new_jobs.description:
Brief Description

Qui est Manmade?

Nous sommes un détaillant en ligne de produits essentiels de première qualité basé à Montréal, connu particulièrement jusqu'à présent pour nos boxer pour hommes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide depuis notre lancement en 2021, et la marque est véritablement à un tournant pour devenir un nom familier au Canada, et elle se développe déjà en parallèle sur le marché américain.

Qui recherchons-nous?

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de l’analytique marketing
pour bâtir et diriger la fonction d’analytique marketing de Manmade.

Vous serez responsable de la façon dont nous mesurons et interprétons la performance marketing, en regroupant les données de nos différents canaux pour offrir une vision claire et fiable des facteurs qui contribuent aux résultats de l’entreprise. Une priorité sera de créer une source de référence unique et centralisée
pour la performance marketing et de mettre en place les tableaux de bord, les indicateurs clés de performance et les cadres de mesure qui guideront les décisions de nos équipes.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior avec une forte implication opérationnelle
. Vous devrez explorer les données, créer des tableaux de bord, analyser la performance et résoudre vous-même les problèmes, tout en établissant les bases d’une équipe et d’une fonction capables d’évoluer avec Manmade.

Si vous aimez transformer des données complexes en décisions d’affaires claires et souhaitez bâtir une fonction à partir de zéro, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?

Nous nous développons rapidement, les choses changent vite et une présence en interne est nécessaire.

Ce que nous offrons?
Nous pensons qu'un travail de qualité commence par un environnement de qualité. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous bénéficierez de déjeuners quotidiens gratuits, de collations et de boissons pour vous permettre de rester en forme et concentré. Nous offrons une assurance de groupe payée à 100 %, des salaires compétitifs qui sont révisés régulièrement avec des augmentations annuelles garanties, et une structure de primes de partage des bénéfices pour que tout le monde participe à notre succès.

Nous sommes dans une phase de croissance, ce qui signifie de réelles opportunités pour vous d'apprendre, de vous développer et de faire passer votre carrière au niveau supérieur. Avant tout, vous ferez partie d'une culture amusante, innovante et respectueuse où vos idées sont valorisées et où votre impact est réel.

Responsabilités

Bâtir et prendre en charge la fonction d’analytique et de mesure marketing de Manmade, tant pour l’acquisition que pour la fidélisation de la clientèle.
Créer une source de référence unique pour la performance marketing en regroupant les données de Meta, Google, TikTok, du marketing par courriel, du marketing d’influence, de Shopify et de l’analytique Web.
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance et des rapports offrant aux équipes Marketing et à la direction une vision claire de la performance.
Analyser les indicateurs clés, notamment le coût d’acquisition client (CAC), la valeur vie client (LTV), le rendement des dépenses publicitaires (ROAS), le ratio d’efficacité marketing (MER), la rétention, la conversion, les cohortes de clients et la performance des canaux.
Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing et Finance pour relier les investissements et la performance marketing aux revenus, à la rentabilité par client et à une croissance rentable.
Évaluer la performance des canaux, des campagnes, des audiences et des créations publicitaires, puis traduire les résultats en recommandations claires et concrètes.
Développer l’approche de Manmade en matière d’attribution, d’incrémentalité, d’expérimentation et de mesure marketing, notamment au moyen de tests A/B, de tests géographiques et de groupes témoins.
Consolider et valider les données provenant des différentes plateformes afin de garantir l’exactitude et la fiabilité des rapports.
Mener des analyses approfondies pour répondre à des questions d’affaires complexes et repérer des occasions d’amélioration en matière d’acquisition, de fidélisation et de valeur vie client.
Mettre en place des processus, des outils et une infrastructure analytiques capables de soutenir la croissance, et définir la feuille de route de la fonction.
Maintenir une forte implication opérationnelle tout en bâtissant et en dirigeant, à terme, une équipe d’analytique marketing performante.

Éxigences

De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience progressive en analytique marketing, en analytique de croissance, en intelligence d’affaires, en analyse de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
Solide expérience en commerce électronique, en vente directe aux consommateurs (DTC), dans le secteur des produits de consommation ou au sein d’une autre entreprise numérique à forte croissance.
Expérience démontrée dans la création ou le développement d’une fonction d’analytique marketing, notamment les tableaux de bord, les cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance, les rapports et les processus de mesure.
Maîtrise avancée de SQL et d’Excel, ainsi qu’une solide expérience avec des outils d’intelligence d’affaires comme Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des outils similaires.
Expérience avec Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok et d’autres plateformes de marketing numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du CAC, de la LTV, du ROAS, du MER, de la rétention, de la conversion, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’attribution et de la rentabilité par client.
Expérience en expérimentation marketing et en mesure de l’incrémentalité, notamment les tests A/B, les tests géographiques et les groupes témoins.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la performance marketing aux résultats commerciaux et financiers de l’entreprise.
Capacité à définir la stratégie analytique tout en explorant personnellement les données et en développant des solutions.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à traduire des données complexes en constats clairs pour les équipes Marketing, Finance et la direction.
Une expérience dans la constitution d’équipes, le mentorat ou la gestion de professionnels en analytique est fortement souhaitée.
Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

Who is Manmade?

We’re a Montreal-based online retailer of premium quality essentials, known particularly so far for our men’s boxer briefs. We have been rapidly growing since launching in 2021, and the brand is truly at a turning point to becoming a household name in Canada, and already growing rapidly in parallel in the US market.

Who is Manmade looking for?

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing Analytics
to build and lead Manmade’s marketing analytics function.

You’ll own how we measure and understand marketing performance, bringing together data across our channels to create a clear, trusted view of what’s driving the business. A key priority will be building a unified source of truth
for marketing performance and establishing the dashboards, KPIs, and measurement frameworks our teams use to make decisions.

This is a senior but deeply hands-on role
. You’ll be expected to dig into the data, build dashboards, analyze performance, and solve problems yourself while creating the foundation for a team and function that can scale with Manmade.

If you love turning complex data into clear business decisions and want the opportunity to build something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Is this for you?

We are growing so rapidly so things are changing so quickly and an in-house presence is required

What are we offering?
Aside from a competitive compensation package, the opportunity in itself is what you make of it. With the company growing 250%+ year over year for the past 3 years, and with expected growth to continue at a high pace for the next 2-3 years, there will be many different ways to grow within the company as it enters new markets, channels, and so on.

We offer extended health and dental benefits, 100% fully paid by the employer. We offer catered lunches every day and all the snacks, drinks, coffee, and fruit you could want.

Responsibilities

Own and build Manmade’s marketing analytics and measurement function across customer acquisition and retention.
Create a unified source of truth for marketing performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, Email, Influencer, Shopify, and web analytics.
Build and maintain dashboards, KPI frameworks, and reporting that give Marketing and leadership a clear view of performance.
Analyze key metrics including CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, customer cohorts, and channel performance.
Partner with Marketing and Finance to connect marketing investment and performance to revenue, customer economics, and profitable growth.
Evaluate channel, campaign, audience, and creative performance and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Develop Manmade’s approach to attribution, incrementality, experimentation, and marketing measurement, including A/B tests, geo studies, and holdouts.
Consolidate and validate data across platforms, ensuring reporting is accurate, reliable, and trusted.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to answer complex business questions and identify opportunities across acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value.
Build scalable analytics processes, tools, and infrastructure, and establish the roadmap for the function as Manmade grows.
Remain deeply hands-on while eventually building and leading a high-performing marketing analytics team.

Qualifications

7–10 years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong experience in e-commerce, DTC, consumer, or another high-growth digital business.
Proven experience building or scaling a marketing analytics function, including dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting, and measurement processes.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel, with strong experience in BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience with Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok, and other digital marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, cohort analysis, attribution, and customer economics.
Experience with marketing experimentation and incrementality, including A/B testing, geo testing, and holdouts.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing performance to broader business and financial outcomes.
Ability to operate at both levels: setting analytics strategy while personally digging into the data and building solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for Marketing, Finance, and leadership.
Experience building, mentoring, or leading analytics talent is strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.
